HEAD is single-parent commit, repo history contains merge commits → is_merge_commit FALSE

fetch-depth=1 / shallow clone: git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD works

canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.scenario: Canonical repair no-ff merge commit on work/canonical-mainline-repair-001
canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.old_behavior: git log --merges might miss no-ff merge → False → round-id gate blocks repair
canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.new_behavior: git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD detects parent_count=2 → True → round-id check skipped

canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.scenario: Single-parent commit after rollback on work/canonical-mainline-repair-001
canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.old_behavior: git log --merges finds historical merge → True → incorrectly skips round-id check
canonical_repair_routing_compatibility.new_behavior: git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD → parent_count=1 → False → round-id check enforced
